title: Finite internal-etale realization with Tor intervals and direct image
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with its discrete topology and continuous-map condensed ring $\underline A$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. For each separated finite-type $k$-scheme $T$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], put $B_T=p_T^*\underline A$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and use internal $B_T$-modules with their ordinary unbounded derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and $\nu_T$ for site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $E_T$ be the derived section-action equivalence from internal $B_T$-modules to ordinary constant-$A$ pro-etale modules, using the constant-ring identification [lem-sf-module-object-ordinary-coefficient-equivalence], and put $\mathcal F_T=E_T^{-1}\nu_T^*$. For every $a\le b$, $\mathcal F_T$ is an equivalence from bounded constructible etale complexes [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] of Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude] to constant-model bounded constructible internal complexes [sk-def-sfb-constructible] of Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ against all degree-zero internal modules [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude].
For every quasi-compact quasi-separated $k$-morphism $f:V\to T$ between these schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and every $L\in D^+(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, there is a natural isomorphism in the full internal derived category
$$\mathcal F_T(Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{\mathrm{int},*}(\mathcal F_V L).$$
Here $D^+$ means cohomology vanishes in sufficiently negative degrees [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}$ is ordinary total derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and $Rf_{\mathrm{int},*}$ is the specified total right derived module-object direct image [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The isomorphism uses these functors on the full unbounded derived categories, restricted to the stated bounded-below inputs. Zero coefficients and empty schemes are allowed.

proof.text: Let P be the recorded etale constructible predicate intersected with its fixed Tor interval, Q the analogous internal predicate, C the fixed-module derived site inverse image, and e the supplied fixedDerived encoding. Lift P.ι followed by C and e.inverse to Q. The encoding counit transports constructibility and Tor amplitude to prove membership. The etale objects in P are bounded below, so lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-derived-hom-bijection gives fullness and faithfulness of P.ι followed by C, inherited by the composite and the full-subcategory lift. For essential surjectivity, encode an object K of Q, descend it using step 2, reflect its Tor interval by step 3, and compose the descended isomorphism with the encoding unit. Thus the lift is an equivalence. Its composite with Q.ι is definitionally the specified ambient realization, giving Iso.refl for the required natural isomorphism.

It preserves the actual coefficient maps and computes on K-injective resolutions. Conjugate this isomorphism by the inverse encoding equivalences using Iso.isoCompInverse and Iso.inverseCompIso.

proof.text: The source theorem nonempty_iso_comparisonUpperStar_comp_rightDerivedLowerStar applies the fixed-module bounded-below direct-image comparison for the qcqs morphism f, namely prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image. Whisker its isomorphism by Plus.ι. The explicit source isomorphism src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility identifies each bounded-below right derived direct image with the restriction of the unbounded functor. The exact-functor mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility identifies the restrictions of comparison inverse image. Compose these natural isomorphisms with associators to obtain the ordinary comparison in the full unbounded category, restricted to all bounded-below inputs. No constructibility or Tor hypothesis is imposed on these inputs.

proof.text: Whisker the ordinary comparison of step 6 by the inverse target encoding. Reassociate, then whisker the inverse conjugated encoding-pushforward comparison of step 5 by the derived site inverse image and Plus.ι. The composite has exactly the required domain and codomain, using the fixed supplied E at both schemes. This proves the second conjunct and completes the theorem. All arguments allow the zero coefficient ring, empty schemes, degenerate intervals and arbitrary bounded-below inputs.

lean.note: The normalized section-action Encoding is used in its fixed-scalar presentation: comparisonUpperStar followed by Encoding.fixedDerived.inverse. Its intrinsic fixed-scalar equivalence cancels between the intrinsic site pullback and Encoding.ordinaryDerived.inverse. The equivalence is tied to this ambient functor; the natural direct-image isomorphism is between full unbounded functors precomposed with the bounded-below inclusion. No new coefficient, constructibility, Tor, or direct-image notion is introduced.
